description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'BaseDao' used as a Data Access Object (DAO) base class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides common database query functionalities such as counting results, setting sorting, and pagination parameters for Doctrine ORM QueryBuilder instances. The class leverages traits for ORM helper methods and interacts with filter parameters to construct dynamic queries.

classes.name: BaseDao
classes.description: An abstract class providing common data access methods for entities, including counting, sorting, and pagination using Doctrine ORM's QueryBuilder.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of results for a given QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: setSortingParams
methods.description: Applies sorting parameters to the QueryBuilder based on provided FilterParams.

methods.name: setPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies pagination limits to the QueryBuilder based on FilterParams.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Combines sorting and pagination configurations on the QueryBuilder using FilterParams.
